headline: Bush order changes an earlier order that directed federal agencies to speed up reviews and permits for energy projects.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13212, a 2001 order that told federal agencies to speed up their work on energy-related projects, such as permit decisions, and set up a task force to help. The title does not say exactly what was changed, and no summary was provided. The details of the amendment cannot be confirmed from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that review or permit energy projects
who_it_affects.how: They remain under the earlier order's direction to speed up energy project decisions, with whatever changes this amendment made.

who_it_affects.group: Companies seeking federal approval for energy projects
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by changes to how the government speeds up reviews of their projects.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 15, 2003; the exact effective date is not stated in the source material.
